The moment that decides the deal

Every deal has one sentence that changes everything.

Pick a moment

Tap any moment below. See the reflex most of us fall back on, and the calm response our members rehearse until it's automatic.

The rate objectionWednesday role-play

Buyer"We love the house, but we'll wait until rates come down."

The reflex"Rates actually aren't that bad, and prices could go up…"

The advantage"That makes sense. What rate would you need to see to feel ready to move?"

Why it worksYou stop arguing with the market and start planning around their number.

Sound familiar?

You don't have a lead problem. You have a conversation problem.

Skill isn't the issue. Pressure is. Without practice, even great professionals reach for the reflex.

What membership includes →

  • Buyers stuck on the sidelines.

    Rates spooked them, pre-approvals are going stale, and every nudge you give them sounds like a sales pitch.

  • The fee conversation, at every listing.

    Since the commission rules changed, sellers ask. Too many of us discount before we've shown what the fee pays for.

  • Check-ins that feel like nagging.

    "Just checking in" gets ignored. So you go quiet, and the client goes with whoever called at the right moment.

  • Agent and lender, out of step.

    Referral partners who never quite click, and clients who hear two different stories. The partnership should be your edge.

  • Training that never sticks.

    You read the book and filled the notebook. Then a real client said something real, and the old habits came back.

  • Nobody safe to practice with.

    Office mates are competitors and family has heard enough. So your first rep is always live, with a deal on the line.

Our approach →
How it works

Practice makes permanent.

01

Learn the phrase

A short lesson on one phrase and the moment it's built for. Five minutes, not five hours.

02

Rehearse it live

Say it out loud on Wednesday with peers who push back like real clients. Stumble here, not at the kitchen table.

03

Use it now

Take it into your next call, then share what happened. That's how the words become your own.

About us

The most powerful tool in real estate is the conversation.

Not a CRM. Not a marketing funnel. Not a social media strategy. The conversation.

Our story

Built by two professionals who saw too many good deals lost.

The Conversation Advantage is an online community for real estate and mortgage professionals who want to master the conversations that lead to more closings, stronger referrals and lasting client relationships.

Laurie Savino and Cheryl Braunschweiger created it after watching talented agents and loan officers lose deals they should have won, over the words they chose in the moment. There was no dedicated community for our industry built around conversation skills. So we built one.

It's guided by the Exactly What to Say methodology from our mentor, Phil M. Jones, and shaped over months of work alongside him.

What makes this different

A community, not a classroom.

There's no shortage of real estate training. Most of it hands you a script and sends you on your way.

The Conversation Advantage is built around real conversations with real professionals who are practicing, sharing and getting better together. You won't just learn what to say. You'll learn how to think on your feet, read the moment and respond in a way that builds trust and moves people to action.

Why we're building this

Three goals that guide everything we do.

Conversion

Improve conversion through conversation

Every interaction is an opportunity. We help you turn everyday conversations at open houses, on calls and in DMs into real business. When you know what to say and when to say it, closings follow.

Live training

Provide ongoing live training

This isn't a one-and-done program. Consistent live sessions let you learn, practice and sharpen your skills in real time, instead of watching a replay and hoping it sticks.

Community

Build a collaborative community

The best ideas come from many people, not one. This is a place where real estate and mortgage professionals show up for each other, share what's working and grow together. A room full of people who get it.

What we stand for

Eight values. Every session.

I

Integrity in influence

We use language to create clarity and confidence, never pressure, manipulation or fear.

II

Practice over theory

We build skill through repetition and structure until effective communication becomes automatic.

III

Calm authority

We communicate with composure, precision and leadership, especially in high-pressure moments.

IV

Client-centered clarity

We guide decisions by uncovering criteria, needs and truth, so the next step is clear.

V

Accountability with support

We show up, do the work and improve together, without shame, excuses or shortcuts.

VI

Excellence in execution

We respect detail, timing and language. Small refinements create meaningful results.

VII

Professional generosity

We share insight, feedback and wins. We compete in the market, not within the community.

VIII

Confidentiality and trust

What's shared in coaching stays in coaching. We protect clients, deals and each other.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Don't see yours? Write to us at connect@theconversationadvantage.com.

The community
Is this for new agents or seasoned pros?

Both. Newer agents learn the words before bad habits set in. Experienced agents and loan officers sharpen the conversations that cost them the most.

I'm a loan officer. Is this really for me?

Yes. The community is built for both sides of the deal. Scenarios cover rate objections, stale pre-approvals and agent partnerships, alongside the agent conversations.

Do I need to have read Exactly What to Say?

No. We teach each phrase from scratch and show it in real estate and lending situations. If you have read it, this is where you put it to work.

Is what I share kept private?

Yes. What's shared in coaching stays in coaching. We protect clients, deals and each other.

Live sessions
When are the role-play sessions?

Every Wednesday.

Do I have to role-play in front of everyone?

Only when you're ready. Many members watch a session or two first. Most find a supportive room makes the first rep easier than they expected.

Membership
How long does the founder's price last?

Your founder's price stays the same for as long as you're a member. If you cancel and later return, you'll rejoin at the current rate.

Can I cancel?

Yes, you can cancel at any time.

Do you offer brokerage or team pricing?

Yes. Contact us at connect@theconversationadvantage.com for custom pricing and packages.
